title: Grateful Dead Live at Alpine Valley Music Theatre on 1986-06-28
lineage: The Master Cassettes were played back with Azimuth adjustment on a Nakamichi CD1 into a Korg MR1000 at DSF 1 bit 5.6MHz. Subsequent conversion to 24/96 AIFF done via Korg Audiogate software. Redbook CDR standard 16/44.1 files were created using Bias Peak, Izotope Ozone's MBIT+ (for all dithering), and Weiss Saracon SRC (all sample rate conversions)
source: 2 Nakamichi CM100s/ CP4>Sony WMD6 w/Teac MDX90 cassette masters. No Dolby was used on the Master Cassettes. Sec 2 Row SS Seat 102 Stand head height

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear soundboard capture of Alpine's high‑energy set, highlighted by a soaring Playing in the Band → Uncle John’s Band sequence and a standout China Doll.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as crystal clear and faithful to the night at Alpine, offering an excellent soundboard source that lets every jangly keyboard chord and ringing guitar note shine. Musically the show dazzles with a tight, driven second set – the Playing‑in‑the‑Band → Uncle John’s Band suite, a unique pre‑drums jam, and a soaring China Doll – all delivered with high‑octane group interplay.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers give 4–5 stars and highlight both an outstanding performance and excellent, clear recording quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear, crisp mix with no muddiness; praised as a faithful capture of the live sound.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set is concise but high‑energy, featuring a jangly pre‑drums jam, a tight Playing → UJB sequence, and a powerful drum segment that propels the show forward.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Shines on China Doll with ringing counterpoint chords; his guitar work is highlighted throughout the second set.
band_member_comments.Bob: Out‑of‑hand in the pre‑drums keyboard jam, providing wonderful jangly chords.
band_member_comments.Keys: Bobby (keyboard) delivers a vibrant, soaring jam before drums that reviewers describe as 'outta hand' and 'jangle‑rich'.
band_member_comments.Drums: High‑energy, 7:30 full‑band jam leading into powerful drum segment.
